youtube_description:
A week after defensive player Shante Carver knocked out Jeff Brohm, the Orlando QB was back on the field ready to play against the Las Vegas Outlaws.

What makes this video so unique is Jeff answering the sideline reporters' question with two questions.

When the reporter asked him, "Jeff Brohm, how in the world are you starting this game tonight after taking that hit six days ago"?

He answered, "Well let me answer that question by asking you two questions. 

One: Is this or is this not the XFL? Yes it is. 

Two: Do I or do I not currently have a pulse? Yes I do, let's play football"

The crowd goes nuts!
youtube_title: Jeff Brohm's Famous Words: "Let's Play Football"
